# TLS syslog receiver and local forwarding configuration

global(
    DefaultNetstreamDriver="gtls"
    DefaultNetstreamDriverCAFile="/etc/rsyslog/certs/ca-cert.pem"
    DefaultNetstreamDriverCertFile="/etc/rsyslog/certs/localhost-cert.pem"
    DefaultNetstreamDriverKeyFile="/etc/rsyslog/certs/localhost-key.pem"
)

# TLS server: present certificate and require/verify client certificate
module(load="imtcp"
    StreamDriver.Name="gtls"
    StreamDriver.Mode="1"
    StreamDriver.AuthMode="x509/name"
    PermittedPeer="localhost"
)
input(type="imtcp" port="6514" ruleset="remoteTLS")

# Monitor application access log; treat each line as an app-access local1 message
module(load="imfile")
input(type="imfile"
    File="/var/log/app/access.log"
    Tag="app-access"
    Facility="local1"
    Severity="info"
    PersistStateInterval="1"
    reopenOnTruncate="on"
)

# Remote receiver storage layout
template(name="RemoteHostTree" type="string"
    string="/var/log/remote/%HOSTNAME%/%$YEAR%/%$MONTH%/%$DAY%/syslog.log")

# Receive-only ruleset: write messages but do not forward them again
ruleset(name="remoteTLS") {
    action(type="omfile"
        dynaFile="RemoteHostTree"
        createDirs="on"
        dirCreateMode="0755"
        fileCreateMode="0644"
    )
}

# Forward all locally generated syslog messages and imfile records over TLS
action(type="omfwd"
    target="localhost"
    port="6514"
    protocol="tcp"
    TCP_Framing="octet-counted"
    StreamDriver="gtls"
    StreamDriverMode="1"
    StreamDriverAuthMode="x509/name"
    StreamDriverPermittedPeers="localhost"
    action.resumeRetryCount="-1"
    queue.type="LinkedList"
    queue.filename="fwdq"
    queue.spoolDirectory="/var/spool/rsyslog"
    queue.saveOnShutdown="on"
    queue.maxDiskSpace="100m"
)
EOF
